refused.packageWords: This engine runs two statements: list, and get followed by a name.
refused.sentence: The provider package's execute failed (INTERNAL_ERROR); the server's log holds its words.

overBound.sentence: The statement is 65 bytes in UTF-8, over the 64-byte limit for this connection type. Shorten it to run it.

agent.objective: Which names does the store hold?
agent.prose: A list read answers every name the store holds. Plan mode sends no statement.
agent.notReviewed: Agent mode runs statements only on the engines whose read-only statement path Studio has reviewed, and In-memory key-value fixture is not one of them, so a run whose workflow sends a statement is not opened on it. Plan mode drafts here.

mcp.notOffered: This connection is not available to MCP: LibreDB Studio does not offer its engine to MCP clients, so an operator removes mcp from this seed.
